papers.title: Lunar regolith - AlSi10Mg composite fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei, 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haihong Zhu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Hubei, 430074, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究月球土壤与AlSi10Mg的复合材料的选区激光熔化，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on space materials (lunar regolith) for additive manufacturing, with no biomedical context, no implant validation, no stress shielding or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索利用月球土壤进行原位增材制造的可能性
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备月球土壤与AlSi10Mg复合材料
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了复合材料，分析了微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和力学测试验证材料特性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of in-situ additive manufacturing using lunar regolith combined with AlSi10Mg alloy.
summary_en.method: Composite specimens were fabricated by selective laser melting of lunar regolith simulant and AlSi10Mg powder mixtures.
summary_en.result: The composite exhibited good densification and mechanical properties, with potential for in-space manufacturing applications.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization via SEM and mechanical testing (compression/hardness) were performed to validate material properties.

papers.title: Patient Satisfaction After Total Hip Arthroplasty Is Not Influenced by Reductions in Opioid Prescribing
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, NYU Langone Health, New York City, NY

corresponding_authors.name: David A. Bloom
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, NYU Langone Health, New York City, NY

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋置换术后阿片类药物处方与患者满意度的关系，与生物力学或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; no FEA or biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究减少阿片类药物处方是否影响全髋置换术后患者满意度
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究比较阿片类药物处方变化前后的患者满意度
summary_zh.result: 减少阿片类药物处方并未降低患者满意度

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether reductions in opioid prescribing after total hip arthroplasty affect patient satisfaction.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing patient satisfaction scores before and after implementation of opioid prescribing reductions.
summary_en.result: Reductions in opioid prescribing did not significantly impact patient satisfaction after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.validation: Clinical data analysis of patient-reported outcomes.
